classico.name: Nuxiva Classic
classico.summary: One model at a time, in the configured order, until one answers

veloce.name: Nuxiva Fast
veloce.summary: Race between the fast models: the first valid answer wins

empatico.name: Nuxiva Empathic
empatico.summary: Compares two answers and picks the clearest, most tone-aware one

pro.name: Nuxiva Pro
pro.summary: Compares two deep models and a critic picks the best answer

ultra.name: Nuxiva Ultra
ultra.summary: Compares up to three deep models with more time and picks with the critic

auto.name: Nuxiva Auto
auto.summary: Picks the method by itself from the question length and the emotional state

stages.reason_fast: you are agitated and the question is short
stages.reason_complex: the question is long and complex

sequential.name: One model at a time
sequential.detail: Tries {count} model groups in order and stops at the first that answers

first.name: Race between fast models
first.detail: {count} models in parallel: the first valid answer wins, the others are stopped

best.name: Comparison between models
best.detail: {count} models in parallel: after the first answer it waits at most {wait} s for the others

decision.name: Chosen answer
decision.detail: The answer with the highest score is returned
